Tess (AE): Quick heads-up — HarborOne wants a POC to switch from CompetitorX. Requirements: drop-in compatibility, a clear token-cost delta, security questionnaire answers, and an assurance on fallback behavior. Can we triage?
Marco (SE): Do they need exact endpoint parity (/v1/generate) or just semantic parity? That determines adapter surface area.
Tess (AE): They said minimal client changes — prefer keeping existing paths and streaming frame shapes.
Ava (Solutions): We can build a small facade that exposes CompetitorX-like endpoints and translates frames and tool payloads. I'll draft a mapping table and a tiny sample adapter.
Marco (SE): Streaming nuance: CompetitorX streams frames like {kind:"part", idx, chunk} and ends with {kind:"end"}. Our runtime streams token deltas. Adapter should reframe tokens into their "part" events to avoid client changes.
Ava (Solutions): Example shim (pseudo):
```
for chunk in read_redwood():
  emit_json({"kind":"part","idx":i,"chunk":chunk})
on_close: emit_json({"kind":"end"})
```
Marco (SE): Tool mapping: CompetitorX returns tool outputs under `tool_result`; we use `function_output`. Adapter must map both shapes and preserve `tool_id` + `req_id`.
Noel (Security): Security asks: EU-only residency, KMS + CMK option, IP allowlist, SSO/SCIM, SOC2 pointer, and an attestation that automatic fallback won't forward raw prompts. They need the questionnaire back by Thu EOD.
Rick (Infra): Latency target: p99 < 240ms for short completions. I can reserve a small Dedicated pool in eu-west for the POC if scope confirmed today. Canary plan: facade in staging, dedicated pool+smoke, then 5% canary with rollback on latency/error/regression.
legal-bot: note: include a no-forwarding clause for raw request/response bodies in the POC addendum.
Ava (Solutions): For billing parity I'll run a token-diff on their 300-sample corpus and produce per-request deltas + a projected monthly delta. Command I'll run: `python tools/token_diff.py --a competitorx-v1 --b redwood-2026 --i harbor_samples.jsonl --o harbor_deltas.csv`.
Tess (AE): HarborOne wants a demo in 6 business days. Can the team commit?
Marco (SE): Yes if scope limited to /v1/generate and we get the sample corpus + header list today. I'll aim to push a prototype adapter in 48h.
Noel (Security): I'll populate the questionnaire and draft the fallback attestation by Thu EOD.
Ava (Solutions): Eval harness (200 prompts) will measure exact-match, normalized edit distance, and embedding cosine. Will containerize so HarborOne can run locally.
Tess (AE): Great — I'll request the corpus and schedule a 20-min kickoff tomorrow. Thanks everyone :handshake:
